name.en: GT2 closed belt loop, 188 mm, 6 mm
name.es: Banda GT2 cerrada de 188 mm y 6 mm
name.fr: Courroie GT2 fermée de 188 mm, 6 mm
name.pt: Correia GT2 fechada de 188 mm e 6 mm

description.en: A closed GT2 (Gates PowerGrip GT, 2MR pitch) timing belt loop, 188 mm pitch length and 6 mm wide. A Voron 2.4-class Z drive runs one between the 16-tooth motor pulley and the 80-tooth pulley on its output shaft, the 5:1 reduction. It has no ends, so it mates nothing: an assembly declares it as a closed belt path round the two pulleys.
description.es: Una banda síncrona GT2 cerrada (Gates PowerGrip GT, paso 2MR) de 188 mm de longitud primitiva y 6 mm de ancho. Un accionamiento Z de clase Voron 2.4 lleva una entre la polea de 16 dientes del motor y la de 80 dientes de su flecha de salida, la reducción 5:1. No tiene extremos, así que no se acopla a nada: un ensamble la declara como una trayectoria de banda cerrada alrededor de las dos poleas.
description.fr: Une courroie crantée GT2 fermée (Gates PowerGrip GT, pas 2MR) de 188 mm de longueur primitive et 6 mm de large. Un entraînement Z de classe Voron 2.4 en fait tourner une entre la poulie moteur à 16 dents et la poulie à 80 dents de son arbre de sortie, la réduction 5:1. Elle n'a pas d'extrémités et ne s'assemble donc à rien : un assemblage la déclare comme un trajet de courroie fermé autour des deux poulies.
description.pt: Uma correia sincronizada GT2 fechada (Gates PowerGrip GT, passo 2MR) de 188 mm de comprimento primitivo e 6 mm de largura. Um acionamento Z de classe Voron 2.4 usa uma entre a polia de 16 dentes do motor e a de 80 dentes do eixo de saída, a redução 5:1. Não tem extremidades, por isso não acopla a nada: uma montagem declara-a como um percurso de correia fechado à volta das duas polias.

frame_convention: A closed loop has no ends and no mating interface, so no frame is placed on it: its geometry is the belt path an assembly declares (ASM-1 §9), the pitch line wrapped round the pulleys it names.

tooth_count.note: derived: the 188 mm pitch length (guide p. 34) over the 2 mm pitch (source 0)

width.note: the Voron 2.4 motion set's loop is 6 mm wide; 6 is a Gates 2MR standard width (source 0)

height.note: B, the overall belt height, back to tooth tip

loop_length.note: the pitch length of the closed loop

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P6-ZBED lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The commons z-drive-housing's default centre distance (40.8 mm) closes this loop on the 16- and 80-tooth pitch diameters (10.19, 50.93) at 188.006 mm. The pitch-line differential is not cited, so no side offsets: the loop runs teeth-on-toothed pulleys only.
